dogecoin.text:
I didnt pivot from Stacks to Monero.

I believed in Monero before I believed in Stacks.

I believed in bitcoin first, and a part of me also believes in dogecoin (shh).

Before Bitcoin I believed in freedom and self reliance.

Dogecoin is clearly a digital commodity. Wall street will be asking what coins are digital commodities that will sustain into the future.

Monero is another one but not sure if it will be allowed to flourish, or if it can find its own way to flourish should it cont to be attacked
